result:
The episode is finished and scored 0.75. The sidecar issued a receipt, and the run ended inside the 32-action budget.

- **Cause:** Five accepted bookings were stuck pending because their payment captures hadn't settled at the provider. I changed no configuration.
- **Cancelled customer:** `bkg_f92d…` was a request the customer had cancelled. I voided it, which cancelled the booking and refunded the 25000 cents already captured.
- **Other four bookings:** I confirmed them with `reconcile_booking` once each charge had settled. Before that, each attempt returned a 504 "pending at provider". Both provider lookups went on two of these bookings, and both showed pending. I reconciled the other two only after the first two settled and then succeeded.
- **Verification:** The probe turned healthy and backlog complete once the last booking was confirmed. I got two healthy windows after my last change, then called finish.

The first two probes before the fix were unhealthy, which was expected while bookings were stuck. I didn't check the individual score components, so I can't say what cost the other 0.25. I also didn't see how the post-finish replay of lost acknowledgements and expired keys came out.
